(MR. PURSHOTTAM TANWAR - PANEL LAWYER FOR RESPONDENT NO. 1  - STATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER
The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Jaura, District Morena (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 460/2022 registered for t h e offence punishable under Sections 376, 376 (2) (i), 376 (2)
(n), 323 and 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

Allegation against the present applicant - accused is that he committed rape upon the prosecutrix,
who is a minor girl.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

As per prosecution story, the incident occurred between 11.6.2022 to 15.6.2022,
however, the FIR has been lodged after a delay of one month on 14.7.2022 for which no plausible explanation has been given.
Since the FIR has been lodged after a gap of one month, therefore, FSL report has no significance.
It is further argued that the applicant is in custody since 15.7.2022.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.

Further argument is that applicant is having no criminal antecedents and he is the permanent resident of District Morena (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
O n the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
